title: Replace internal `ShouldDescendExcludedDir` with upstream `c/storage` implementation
body:
PR [container-libs#1006](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1006) adds `ShouldDescendExcludedDir` to `c/storage/pkg/fileutils.PatternMatcher` and fixes `archive.TarWithOptions` to use it.

Once that merges and buildah vendors the updated `c/storage`, we should:
- Remove `internal/excludes/` package and use `PatternMatcher.ShouldDescendExcludedDir()` directly
- Update `copier/copier.go` and `add.go` to call the upstream method

Depends on: [container-libs#1006](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1006)
